---
name: Bug Report
about: Report a bug or issue with JACAMENO
title: '[BUG] '
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## 🐛 Bug Description

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## 📝 Steps to Reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Scroll down to '...'
4. See error

## ✅ Expected Behavior

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## ❌ Actual Behavior

A clear and concise description of what actually happened.

## 🖼️ Screenshots

If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

## 🌍 Environment

**Version**: [e.g., Web 0.9.0, Android 0.9.0]

**Device**:
- Type: [Desktop/Mobile/Tablet]
- Model: [e.g., iPhone 14, Samsung Galaxy S23]
- OS: [e.g., Windows 11, macOS 14, Android 13, iOS 17]

**Browser** (for web version):
- Name: [e.g., Chrome, Safari, Firefox]
- Version: [e.g., 120]

**Screen**:
- Resolution: [e.g., 1920x1080, 390x844]
- Orientation: [Portrait/Landscape]

## 🔥 Severity

- [ ] Critical - Game crashes or becomes unplayable
- [ ] High - Major feature doesn't work
- [ ] Medium - Feature works but has issues
- [ ] Low - Minor visual or cosmetic issue

## 📊 Frequency

How often does this happen?
- [ ] Always (100%)
- [ ] Often (75%)
- [ ] Sometimes (50%)
- [ ] Rarely (25%)
- [ ] Once

## 🎮 Game State (if applicable)

- Score: [your score when bug occurred]
- Level: [level when bug occurred]
- Lines: [lines cleared when bug occurred]
- Current Piece: [which tetromino was active]

## 🔍 Additional Context

Add any other context about the problem here. For example:
- Was there anything unusual happening before the bug?
- Have you experienced this bug before?
- Any workarounds you found?

## 🔗 Related Issues

Link any related issues here (if applicable).

## ✔️ Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to make sure this isn't a duplicate
- [ ] I have provided all the information requested above
- [ ] I have tested this on the latest version
- [ ] I can reliably reproduce this issue

---

**Thank you for taking the time to report this issue! Your feedback helps make JACAMENO better for everyone.**
